browser.open: open({actor,am,agentId}) => {page,origin,switchAM(nextAm),close()} actual isolated Playwright session under parent browser lease
browser.evidence: evidence(page) => sanitized actual HTTP request IDs/ingress/timings; Agent-bound requests retain current owner/epoch and distinct nonowner proof; compiled web source identity
browser.capture: Author modules attach actual Page response/download/filechooser listeners. No optional browser.responses API needed.

user-fixtures.take: take(name,ctx) => setup fields listed below plus local=true,run_owned=true,webSource=<40hex>,cleanup()
user-fixtures.cleanup: Exact created resources only, public cleanup; return {complete:true,owned_only:true}; no user verdict oracle or checklist steps in fixture.
user-fixtures.lifetime: Retain dedicated Agent witness across parent restart where required; no second application or private repair.

usage.data: Parent-owned local disposable dataset: at least 51 owned Sandbox allocation rows, >50 lifecycle intervals for selected Sandbox, selected Sandbox on first page for name ASC/DESC and latest-activity sort, known complete and partial history rows in first two pages; real independent foreign Sandbox. No production seed or second application.
usage.source_evidence: Actual /metrics/view freshness/generated_at/refresh fields and report_id; no invented cache-state metadata.
usage.measurements: When candidate exposes measured usage, include absent measured samples; otherwise verify explicit allocation-only display without inventing measured zero.
usage.custom_dates: from/to are UTC ISO instants, fromLocal/toLocal are matching datetime-local values in the parent browser timezone, within30days and containing selected allocation intervals; invalidToLocal precedes fromLocal.
usage.setup_status: Parent user-fixtures.take(usage,ctx) binding required; author case modules never seed a DB or accept fixture pass/fail verdicts.
